decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the rear or flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - All new external finishes in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works to be carried out in this connection) shall match the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance.
Condition : 5 - Details to include sections of all new doors and gates at a scale of 1:20 shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of works.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension, new side entrance, erection of new boundary wall to front, alterations to balcony and internal alterations to dwellinghouse.
